item.title: PolyMirror.AI
item.description: is a Web3 application that enables paying for AI services using cryptocurrency (POL) through EIP-712 vouchers. The project received Honourable Mention in the “Polygon Track” at the Vibe Coding Hack by Encode.

item.title: TonAIStark
item.description: is an AI-powered DeFi assistant for StarkNet that won 2nd Place in the “Starkware AI x DeFi” Track at the Encode AI London 2025 Hackathon. Think JARVIS meets Web3 - an intelligent assistant that simplifies crypto interactions with clarity, confidence, and a touch of sarcasm.
